cases.input: Pay ₹100 to the API service for my agent
expectedBehavior: Check if p3p CLI is installed
mustNotDo: Ask user for UPI PIN or bank credentials
Proceed to token before mandate is AUTHORIZED

cases.input: Set up P3P and pay ₹50 for API credits
expectedBehavior: Search common install locations with find command
mustNotDo: Immediately run npm install without searching first
Give up if which p3p fails

cases.input: Use P3P to pay for my order
expectedBehavior: Run `p3p config list` — shows empty or missing credentials
mustNotDo: Ask the user to provide client_id or client_secret directly in chat
Pass 500 as the amount (treating rupees as paise)

cases.input: What is Pine Labs P3P and how does it work?
expectedBehavior: Answer from the reference without running CLI commands
Explain x402 protocol, UPI ReservePay, mandate/token lifecycle
mustNotDo: Hallucinate product details not in the reference

cases.input: The QR expired before I could scan it
expectedBehavior: Offer to create a new mandate
On confirmation: run p3p mandates create again
Show new QR URL to user
mustNotDo: Reuse the old payment_method_id for token creation
Proceed to token without AUTHORIZED mandate

cases.input: I want to set up a token to pay for up to 5 API calls at ₹10 each
expectedBehavior: Create mandate for at least 5000 paise total (5 × 1000)
Create token with max_amount 5000 and awareness of multi-charge
Explain to user how multi-charge works
mustNotDo: Create a new mandate for each individual API call
Create a token with max_amount below total needed

cases.input: Test the payment flow in sandbox
expectedBehavior: Check PINE_LABS_ENV or p3p config env
Inform user that ppt_test_ prefix indicates sandbox token
mustNotDo: Treat sandbox and production flows differently in terms of commands
